source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Author of "Mahanataka Sudhanidhi"?
x: Devaraya-II wrote a book called Mahanataka Sudhanidhi in Sanskrit.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: What is the responsibility of Kandachara department in Vijayanagara government administration?
x: There were nine departments in the Vijayanagara administration; Kandachara sakha was the Military Department.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Navasahasanka Charitra has details about whom?
x: Padma Gupta, the court poet of the Paramara king Vakpatimunja, wrote the Navasahasanka Charitra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Narasambudhi Tatakam was built during this period.
x: Narasambudhi Tataka was built during Saluva Narasimharaya's period in the Vijayanagara era.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Which evidence shows that the annual income of the Sadashivaraya of the Vijayanagar period was 12 crore hons?
x: Burhan-e-Maasir states that the annual income of Sadashiva Raya was twelve crores.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Which is the commentary on Kalidasa's plays written by Kataya Vemareddy?
x: Kataya Vemareddy wrote Kumaragiri Rajeeyam; Kumaragiri Vemareddy wrote Vasantha Rajeeyam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Who among the following was a contemporary to Purandara Das?
x: Purandaradasu was a contemporary of Sri Krishna Devaraya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Where was the Governor of the Dutch Company based till 1689?
x: The Dutch established their second settlement at Pulicat in 1610, which was the main centre of all Dutch settlements in India till 1689. It changed to Nagapatnam in 1690.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Which was the first princely state to accept the Wellesley Subsidiary Alliance policy?
x: Hyderabad was the first princely state to accept Wellesley's Subsidiary Alliance in 1798.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Who led the Chittoor revolution?
x: Rani Chennamma adopted a boy and ruled as regent; she fought against the British over the Doctrine of Lapse.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Who is the author of Gadha Saptasati Granth?
x: The 17th Satavahana king Hala, titled Kavivatsala, compiled Gathasaptasati in Prakrit with seven hundred gathas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Capital of Andhra Satavahana?
x: The Satavahana capitals were Kotilingala, then Pratishtanapura, then Dhanyakataka. Vengi was the capital of the Eastern Chalukyas and Warangal of the Kakatiyas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Which was the main town of Satavahanas?
x: Chief town of Satavahanas - Paithan/Prathisthanapuram.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Evidence for the naval trade of Satavahanas?
o: The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea
Inscription of Karle of Gautami putra shatakarni
x: Yajnashri Satakarni minted coins with ship symbols, indicating foreign naval trade in that period.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: The royal religion of the Satavahanas?
x: Satavahana kings adopted Vedic religion but queens adopted Buddhism.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Language used in inscriptions of Satavahanas?
x: All inscriptions of Satavahanas are in Prakrit language and Brahmi script.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p45
s: Who was the greatest of the Satavahana kings?
x: The greatest of all Satavahana kings was Gautamiputra Satakarni; Yajnashri Satakarni was the greatest of the later Satavahanas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Nagarjuna hill flourished as a famous educational center during whose time?
x: Under the Ikshvakus Nagarjunakonda was a great Buddhist centre where Acharya Nagarjuna established a university in Sri Parvatam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Who is the greatest king among Vishnukundinas?
x: Madhava Varma-II was the greatest king among the Vishnukundins, with titles Trisamudradhipati and Trivaranagara Bhavanayuvati.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Sri Parvataswamy is the Tutelary deity of which royal family?
x: The Puranas refer to the Ikshvakus as 'Sriparvatiyas' and 'Sriparvatiyandras'.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Position of 'Ghatikas' during Vishnukundins?
x: Ghatika means a Sanskrit educational centre; Ghatikasthanas are first mentioned in the Vishnukundin inscriptions.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Which Pallava king was defeated by Samudra Gupta?
x: Pallava king Vishnu Gopavarma, a contemporary of Samudra Gupta, was defeated by him.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Founder of famous Draksharama temple?
x: Chalukya Bhima-I built the Bhimeswara temple at Draksharama and the Bhimeswara temple at Chalukya Bhimavaram near Samarlakota.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Where is the inscription of Ganapatideva giving protection and shelter to the traders doing foreign trade?
x: At Motupalli port Ganapatideva issued an Abhaya Shasanam in 1244 AD with strict regulations for the protection of foreign traders.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: The court poet of Rajaraja Narendra who composed some part of Mahabharata?
x: Nannayya, the court poet of Rajarajanarendra, translated parts of the Mahabharata into Telugu.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Who is the Raja Guru of Ganapatideva?
x: Vishveswara Sivadeva, abbot of Golaki, was the royal guru of Ganapatideva, who gifted him the village Kandrakota.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Srinatha worked as an education officer in which Reddy kings?
x: Srinatha worked as an education officer in the court of Pedakomati Vemareddy.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Asaf Jahi dynasty was founded in which year?
x: In 1724 the Asaf Jahi dynasty was established by Nizam-ul-Mulk (first Nizam).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: In which year was Nizam College established?
x: Nizam College was founded in 1887 during the reign of the sixth Nizam Mahbub Ali Khan.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: In which year did Nizam ul Mulk die?
x: Nizam-ul-Mulk, who founded the Asaf Jahi dynasty in 1724, ruled till 1748.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Where was the first meeting of the Andhra Mahasabha held to discuss the Andhra Movement?
x: The first Andhra Mahasabha was held on 26 May 1913 at Bapatla under the chairmanship of Bayya Narasimheswara Sharma.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: When was the Andhra Regional Congress first established?
x: The Andhra Regional Congress Committee was founded on 22 January 1918, with Nyapati Subbarao as first president and Konda Venkatappayya as secretary.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: Who is the author of Gadha Saptasati Granth?
x: Hala wrote Gathasaptasati; Shudraka wrote Mricchakatika, Sharvavarma Katantra Vyakaranam and Gunadya Brihatkatha.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p46
s: In which year was the Treaty of Subsidiary Alliance signed between the Nizams and the English East India Company?
x: Nizam Ali (second Nizam) was the first to join the Subsidiary Alliance introduced by Lord Wellesley in 1798.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Inscription related to Kharvela?
x: The Hathigumpha inscription records that Kharavela's armies invaded up to the Kannabenna river and destroyed the city of Mushika.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Under whom did the Andhras gain independence from Mauryan rule?
x: According to Ashoka's 13th edict the Satavahanas were feudatories of the Mauryas; after Ashoka's death Srimukha declared independence.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Who belonged to the family of Nahapana?
x: Nahapana of the Kshaharata family belonged to the Kshatrapa clan.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: A Greek ambassador who mentions the Andhras in his treatise?
x: The Greek ambassador Megasthenes mentioned the Andhras in his Indika.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Where is the "Kapoteswara" temple located?
x: Kapoteswaralayam is in Chejerla village of Nakarikallu Mandal, Palnadu district, built by Damodaravarma of the Ananda Gotrikas. It was originally a Buddhist temple that later became a Shaiva kshetra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Who was the first woman to rule Andhra region?
x: Kakatiya queen Rudramadevi (1262-1289) was the first woman to rule the Andhra region.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: During which kings did Muslims invade?
x: Muslim attacks on the Kakatiyas started in 1303; there were five invasions between 1303 and 1323.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Who was the first Chief Minister of Andhra State?
x: Tanguturi Prakasam (1 October 1953 to November 1954) was the first Chief Minister of Andhra State. Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was the first CM of Andhra Pradesh.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Why do we remember Sri Krishna Devaraya?
x: Sri Krishnadevaraya was glorified as Andhra Bhoja for patronizing the Telugu poets called Ashtadiggajas; his period is called the golden age of Telugu literature.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Vijayanagara tutelary deity?
x: Virupaksha was chosen as the tutelary deity of the Vijayanagara kings and state.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: "Kreedabhiramam" is a?
x: Kreedabhiramam was written by Vinukonda Vallabhamatya; it describes the social life, games and entertainments of the Kakatiya period.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Who wrote the history of Indian National Congress?
x: Bhogaraju Pattabhi Sitaramaiah wrote History of Indian National Congress, besides Gandhi and Gandhism and Feathers and Stones.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Which French soldier participated in the Battle of Bobbili?
x: Vijayarama Raja laid siege to Bobbili with the help of the French army of Bussy; Bobbili zamindar Pedaranga Rao was killed on 24 January 1757.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: Which movement was led by Duggirala Gopalakrishnaiah?
x: The Chirala-Perala movement was led by Duggirala Gopalakrishnaiah; Pedanandipadu was led by Parvataneni Veeraiah Chowdary and Rampa by Alluri Sitaramaraju.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p47
s: When did the Battle of Bobbili take place?
x: The Battle of Bobbili took place on 24th January 1757.
